verses.en: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
verses.pt: Bom é render graças ao Senhor, e cantar louvores ao teu nome, ó Altíssimo,
verses.en_web: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High;
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. A Song for the Sabbath.> It is a good thing to give praise to the Lord, and to make melody to your name, O Most High;

verses.en: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
verses.pt: anunciar de manhã a tua benignidade, e à noite a tua fidelidade,
verses.en_web: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
verses.en_bbe: To make clear your mercy in the morning, and your unchanging faith every night;

verses.en: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
verses.pt: sobre um instrumento de dez cordas, e sobre o saltério, ao som solene da harpa.
verses.en_web: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
verses.en_bbe: On a ten-corded instrument, and on an instrument of music with a quiet sound.

verses.en: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
verses.pt: Pois me alegraste, Senhor, pelos teus feitos; exultarei nas obras das tuas mãos.
verses.en_web: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
verses.en_bbe: For you, O Lord, have made me glad through your work; I will have joy in the works of your hands.

verses.en: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.pt: Quão grandes são, ó Senhor, as tuas obras! quão profundos são os teus pensamentos!
verses.en_web: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, how great are your works! and your thoughts are very deep.

verses.en: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
verses.pt: O homem néscio não sabe, nem o insensato entende isto:
verses.en_web: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
verses.en_bbe: A man without sense has no knowledge of this; and a foolish man may not take it in.

verses.en: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
verses.pt: quando os ímpios brotam como a erva, e florescem todos os que praticam a iniqüidade, é para serem destruídos para sempre.
verses.en_web: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
verses.en_bbe: When the sinners come up like the grass, and all the workers of evil do well for themselves, it is so that their end may be eternal destruction.

verses.en: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.
verses.pt: Mas tu, Senhor, estás nas alturas para sempre.
verses.en_web: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.
verses.en_bbe: But you, O Lord, are on high for ever.

verses.en: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.pt: Pois eis que os teus inimigos, Senhor, eis que os teus inimigos perecerão; serão dispersos todos os que praticam a iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
verses.en_bbe: For see! your haters, O Lord, will be put to death; all the workers of evil will be put to flight;

verses.en: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
verses.pt: Mas tens exaltado o meu poder, como o do boi selvagem; fui ungido com óleo fresco.
verses.en_web: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
verses.en_bbe: But my horn is lifted up like the horn of the ox: the best oil is flowing on my head.

verses.en: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
verses.pt: Os meus olhos já viram o que é feito dos que me espreitam, e os meus ouvidos já ouviram o que sucedeu aos malfeitores que se levantam contra mim.
verses.en_web: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
verses.en_bbe: My eyes have seen trouble come on my haters; my ears have news of the fate of the evil-doers who have come up against me.

verses.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.pt: Os justos florescerão como a palmeira, crescerão como o cedro no Líbano.
verses.en_web: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.en_bbe: The good man will be like a tall tree in his strength; his growth will be as the wide-stretching trees of Lebanon.

verses.en: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.pt: Estão plantados na casa do Senhor, florescerão nos átrios do nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
verses.en_bbe: Those who are planted in the house of the Lord will come up tall and strong in his gardens.

verses.en: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
verses.pt: Na velhice ainda darão frutos, serão viçosos e florescentes,
verses.en_web: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
verses.en_bbe: They will give fruit even when they are old; they will be fertile and full of growth;

verses.en: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.pt: para proclamarem que o Senhor é reto. Ele é a minha rocha, e nele não há injustiça.
verses.en_web: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.en_bbe: For a sign that the Lord is upright; he is my Rock, there is no deceit in him.
